title: Layout Rules
description: Show fields and sections, make fields mandatory or read-only, narrow options, set or suggest values, show messages and ask users to verify values — based on what is entered in a primary field. Rules apply to one layout and run in order.
descriptionDesk: Show fields and sections or make fields mandatory based on what is entered in a primary field — per department, and optionally on the Help Center ticket form. Rules apply to one layout and run in order.
